contents.text:
The docs don't include a separate program for building your own agent, so I'll share the page's Program.cs and note that it loads the coding agent's CodingCatalog. To build a custom agent, I'd need to write my own catalogue, which the page doesn't cover. For settings, the get-started doc lists ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and AGENT_API_KEY in secrets, while the page puts ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env.secrets.

Next I'm settling how to present the settings and explain the code, keeping it brief, then ending with the doc path and the three options I can offer.
